summary: Day: elevated corner panorama (post-game, partly empty). Night: elevated 2016 game-day crowd shot.

files.note: Wide panorama from the top rows of the north-east corner after a 2013 game (crowd leaving, many empty seats); field rows ~420-760 of 1005 (42-76%), stands and press box rows ~200-420, cloudy sky top ~20%; railing and empty bleachers in the lower-left foreground

files.note: Night game 2016 ('stripe out' crowd), from high in the south-west stands looking across to the press-box side; field rows ~620-1250 of 1477 (42-85%), striped crowd rows ~250-620, lights and black sky in the top ~17%; raised hands of fans along the bottom
